The Remote page has two tabs: **Host** (let another Runova control this computer) and **Connect** (control another Runova).

The first is a remote control that works between Runova installs on the same network. The second is a saved server list.

## Host: let another device control this computer

### Create a pairing code

1. Click **Generate pairing code**. A text code appears.
2. Give the code to the other device: copy the text with **Copy code** and paste it on the other computer.

> [!NOTE]
> Keyboard control needs a Windows host. Pick a <name> for it.

## Tips

- See [SSH](ssh-files.md#keys) and [the Vault](vault.md) for saved logins, or [the top](#host-let-another-device-control-this-computer).
